title: report
description: A page of sections, each a heading over parts: Markdown text, code, commands at a terminal, tables, cards, notes, diagrams, scripts, or HTML for what they cannot say.

eyebrow.description: A short line above the title, such as the kind of page and its date

lead.description: A sentence or two under the title that sums the page up

items.description: One key naming the kind of the part

text.description: Markdown; raw HTML in it is left out. Code goes in code and commands in terminal, short code in a sentence as `code`

code.description: Write every block of code here

terminal.description: Write every command here, without its prompt

html.description: HTML that goes in as it is
